steps.do: Greet the customer. Confirm they want the personal card with the highest cash back. No identity check is needed, because no customer records are looked up or changed.
steps.quote: You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases.

steps.do: Ask for the yearly fee budget, the expected monthly spend and whether the customer has Rho-Bank+, before recommending anything
steps.if: the customer has not already said these
steps.quote: Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.

steps.do: Compare personal cards by cash back rate and by effective annual fee (fee minus rebate). Platinum pays 10.0% on everything for a $200.00 fee, or $50 net if at least $7500.00 is spent in every month. Diamond Elite (5.0%) is by invitation only. Gold (2.5%) needs Rho-Bank+. Crypto-Cash Back pays 2.0%. Silver pays 4.0% on travel and software only, and 1.0% on everything else. EcoCard and Bronze earn about 1% on general spend.
steps.quote: Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.

steps.do: Recommend exactly one card. Choose the Platinum Rewards Card when expected monthly spend is at least $7500.00 every month and the $50 net fee fits the budget. Explain: 10.0% cash back, $200.00 annual fee, $150.00 rebate when the threshold is met in all 12 monthly windows, and a minimum credit score of $750.
steps.if: expected monthly spend >= $7500.00 and $200.00 - $150.00 is within the fee budget
steps.quote: A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.

steps.do: If Platinum's effective fee is over budget, recommend the highest-earning card that fits the budget and that the customer is eligible for. This is Gold at 2.5% only with Rho-Bank+, and otherwise the next highest flat rate. If no card fits, say so.
steps.if: Platinum's effective fee exceeds the customer's budget

steps.do: The customer applies for the recommended card themselves

rules.rule: The rebate requires meeting the threshold in every month of the cardmember year. It is not prorated.
rules.quote: The Platinum Rewards Card annual fee rebate is earned only if you meet the required monthly spending threshold in every month of your cardmember year.

rules.rule: If the first-year fee is waived by a promotion, the rebate does not apply to that year. The first-year waiver promo window ended 2024-12-31.
rules.quote: If your first cardmember year’s annual fee is waived under a promotional offer, the rebate does not apply to that year.

rules.rule: Platinum requires a minimum credit score of $750
The Diamond Elite Card (5.0%, $495.00 fee) is by invitation only. Do not recommend it as something the customer can apply for.
The Gold Rewards Card (2.5%, $0.00 fee) requires Rho-Bank+. A customer without Rho-Bank+ is not eligible.

rules.quote: You earn rewards at 2.0% on those transactions.

rules.quote: Purchases outside top categories earn 1.0% back

rules.quote: Earn 1.0% cash back on all other purchases
